# aphrody_installer crate

> Aphrody OS & Arch Net-Installer + Live Desktop Environment Switcher (Aphrody GPUI, Iced COSMIC, egui Craft, WebGPU, GNOME, KDE, Hyprland, Sway, Niri)…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/aphrody_installer/
